title: The Truth of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji's fingers touched that invitation, the causal threads of the entire Three Realms trembled—Chapter 1155, Chen Ji was about to make a choice that would change everything.

text.content: Light surged into the Mental Sea like a tide, and Chen Ji felt as if he stood on the edge of some boundary. The pattern of the Turtle Shell artifact emerged in his palm, creating a strange resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment—this was not simple fusion, but more like two broken strands of destiny reweaving together. "Finally..." A voice rang from the Void, coming from no direction yet seeming to whisper right beside his ear, "You've come, the final Observer." Chen Ji looked up sharply to see an endless curtain of light, and within it, a pair of eyes piercing through dimensions to gaze at him—the Eyes of Heavenly Dao.

dialogue.content: Do you think you are the one who plays the game?

text.content: The voice of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao carried no temperature, yet it bore an ancient weariness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted slightly as he discovered something similar in those eyes to himself—the confusion of a prisoner. "Correct, you and I are both existences trapped within this chess game." The Eyes of Heavenly Dao seemed to see through his thoughts, "You think the Tianji Record chose you? No, it merely found a relatively qualified substitute among countless chess pieces." Chen Ji said nothing, but the power of the Tianji Record had already gathered at his fingertips, ready to respond at any moment. The residual warmth of the Turtle Shell artifact still lingered in his palm, and that premonition of change grew increasingly intense.

dialogue.content: Within the Three Realms, everything is the chessboard I have laid out. But what about beyond the Three Realms? Have you ever considered whether those higher-dimensional existences are also gazing upon us?

text.content: Chen Ji's heart jolted. The words of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao revealed an astonishing piece of information—even an existence like it felt trapped. "What exactly are you trying to say?" Chen Ji asked in a deep voice. The Tianji Record Fragment in his hand moved without wind. In the light, he saw cracks of exhaustion within those deep eyes. "My purpose, from beginning to end, has only been one thing." The voice of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao suddenly dropped low, "Break this cycle, escape this prison cage. It's just... I took far longer than any of you imagined, yet discovered that relying on my own strength is fundamentally impossible."

dialogue.content: Do you know who the first Observer was?

text.content: This question struck Chen Ji's mind like a thunderbolt. In the history recorded on the Tianji Record Fragment, the first Observer had always been a mystery—no one knew his origin, no one knew his ending, only that he left behind the Tianji Record artifact. "Could it be..." Chen Ji's voice trembled slightly, a wild idea taking shape. "Indeed." The smile of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao transmitted through that formless voice, "The first Observer was my predecessor. We were originally one source."

Chen Ji felt his worldview collapsing. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao shared the same origin as the first Observer? What did this mean? "In the primordial times, there was an Observer who attempted to peer into the Heavenly Secrets. In the end, he sacrificed himself and transformed into the will of Heavenly Dao." The voice of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao carried a hint of self-mockery, "Ridiculous, he thought he was controlling destiny, yet from that moment on, we became playthings of higher-dimensional existences. The Tianji Record, prophecies, destiny... all of them were games they arranged."

dialogue.content: You think the Demonic Path's invasion and the sects' mutual destruction were under my control? No, all of this is merely the projection of those higher existences' will in the mortal realm. And I am nothing more than a puppet forced to execute commands.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent. The light from the Turtle Shell artifact gradually stabilized, and he discovered that his connection with the Tianji Record had indeed undergone a fundamental change—it was no longer passive acceptance, but a kind of active resonance. "So you've searched for countless years, all to find someone who could break the cycle?" he asked, his voice carrying scrutiny. The threat level of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao in his heart was being reassessed. If what it said was true, then the essence of this war was far more complex than he had imagined. Mo Xiansheng had once said that the final truth of the Tianji Record would only reveal what needed to be revealed—now it seemed even Mo Xiansheng himself was part of this chess game.

choice.prompt: Facing the Eyes of Heavenly Dao's revelation, Chen Ji must make a choice:

choices.description: Since the Eyes of Heavenly Dao is also a chess piece, then join hands to break this chess game that imprisons everyone, betting on a complete reversal.
choices.visible_cost: Lose complete control over the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain the dimensional knowledge of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao
choices.risk_hint: The credibility of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao is questionable, it may have other schemes

dialogue.content: You are more decisive than I imagined. Very well, then let us together overturn this chessboard.

choices.description: Do not rush to make a statement, demand that the Eyes of Heavenly Dao show more evidence to prove the truth of what it said.
choices.visible_reward: Gain more complete information about what lies beyond the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: May offend the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, leading to broken cooperation

text.content: The Eyes of Heavenly Dao fell silent for a moment, seemingly surprised by Chen Ji's caution. Then a stream of information flooded into his Mental Sea—that was the true picture of dimensions beyond the Three Realms.

choices.description: Refuse to cooperate with the Eyes of Heavenly Dao, but use the information it revealed to find a method unique to oneself to break fate.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the support of a potential ally
choices.visible_reward: Retain complete control over the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: Face the higher-dimensional existences alone, the odds of victory are extremely low

text.content: Chen Ji's answer caused the Eyes of Heavenly Dao to fall into a brief silence. Then a hint of appreciation actually appeared in those eyes. "Interesting, you are different from those others."

dialogue.content: Regardless of what you choose, one fact will not change—when the Turtle Shell artifact fused with you, you became the key piece in this chess game. Every choice you make is determining the fate of everyone, including me.

text.content: Chen Ji weighed the meaning of these words. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao admitted it was also trapped in the chess game, admitted the first Observer was its predecessor, admitted the existence of higher-dimensional beings—all this information was overwhelming, yet his mind remained calm. The change brought by the Turtle Shell artifact was deepening. He could feel that his connection with the Tianji Record had broken through certain constraints. No longer just passive observation, but active participation and even rewriting. "What do you need me to do?" Chen Ji asked, "Don't tell me you went to great lengths to contact me just to pour out your tragic origins."

dialogue.content: Do what you have always been doing—lay out schemes, calculate, play everyone between your palms. Only this time, the stakes are the fate of the entire Three Realms.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly smiled, a dangerous smile with a chilling edge. "Calculation and scheming is my strongest suit?" he slowly said, "Then why don't you consider, why could atrash servant survive the mutual destruction of three major sects?" For the first time, a fluctuation appeared in the voice of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao—it seemed to realize that this young man was far more difficult to deal with than anticipated. Chen Ji's lips curved into an even deeper arc, "So, rather than you choosing me, it's more accurate to say I'm giving you a chance. The fusion of the Turtle Shell artifact was not coincidental—this was the first move I laid out."

The Eyes of Heavenly Dao's acknowledgment carried genuine surprise. Chen Ji did not relax his vigilance; he was all too aware of what might be hidden behind such "appreciation." Bear grudges but don't act rashly—he recited to himself. The information obtained today was too important and needed careful digestion. More importantly, Chen Nian's matter remained unresolved, and he could not let any variables disrupt his rhythm. The Turtle Shell artifact's fusion had given him more confidence, but it was still not enough. "Chapter 1155," the voice of the Eyes of Heavenly Dao sounded again, "By then I will contact you again. By then, give me your answer—break the cycle, understand the opponent, or find a third path." Those eyes gazing at him gradually receded into the Void, leaving only the final words, "Don't disappoint me, Chen Ji."

The light faded, and Chen Ji found himself still standing in place, the warmth of the Turtle Shell artifact still lingering in his palm. Everything around him had not changed, as if that dimension-spanning conversation had merely been an illusion. But he knew it was real. The Eyes of Heavenly Dao shared origin with the first Observer, there were higher-dimensional existences beyond the Three Realms, and he himself had become the most crucial chess piece in this game. The Tianji Record Fragment burned slightly warm in his Mental Sea. Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded at the right moment: "You did well. Some truths, known too early, are more a curse than a blessing. But now, you can begin to lay out your schemes." Chen Ji gave no answer, only silently calculating every step ahead in his mind. Chen Nian was still in the Holy Sect's hands, Su Qingyao was still secretly investigating him, Ye Qing's cooperation agreement had not yet been fully fulfilled, Ling Yuan's threat always hung over his head—and now, added another invitation from the Eyes of Heavenly Dao. This game of chess was becoming more and more interesting.
